title: Bind Several Optionals
hints: One `if` can bind several optionals and test conditions, separated by commas.
Unwrap each string, convert it with `Int(...)`, and check both are positive — all in the same `if`.
`if let width, let w = Int(width), let height, let h = Int(height), w > 0, h > 0 { return "area \(w * h)" }`.
